Meta description: Ready to run your first 5K? Discover the ultimate beginner's guide. Get free couch-to-5K training plans, expert race day tips, and PNW community support.
"What if I can't finish?" Reality: If you can walk 45 minutes, you can finish.
By Week 8, you'll be ready to run 30 minutes, enough to finish any 5K.
Week 1 Walk More, Run a Little Day 1 Alternate 60s jog / 90s walk × 8 Day 2 Alternate 60s jog / 90s walk × 8 Day 3 Alternate 60s jog / 90s walk × 8 Tip: Go slower than you think you should.
Week 2 Building the Habit Day 1 Alternate 90s jog / 2min walk × 6 Day 2 Alternate 90s jog / 2min walk × 6 Day 3 Alternate 90s jog / 2min walk × 6 Tip: Rest days matter.
Week 3 First 3-Minute Run Day 1 90s jog , 90s walk , 3min jog , 3min walk × 2 Day 2 Repeat Day 1 Day 3 Repeat Day 1 Tip: 3 minutes will feel long.
Week 4 Extending the Runs Day 1 3min jog , 90s walk , 5min jog , 2.5min walk , 3min , 90s , 5min Day 2 Repeat Day 1 Day 3 Repeat Day 1 Tip: Halfway there!
Week 5 The 20-Minute Breakthrough Day 1 5min jog , 3min walk , 5min jog , 3min walk , 5min jog Day 2 8min jog , 5min walk , 8min jog Day 3 20min jog (no walking!) Tip: Day 3 is a milestone.
Week 6 Building Consistency Day 1 5min jog , 3min walk , 8min jog , 3min walk , 5min jog Day 2 10min jog , 3min walk , 10min jog Day 3 22min jog Tip: You're a runner now.
Week 7 Nearly There Day 1 25min jog Day 2 25min jog Day 3 25min jog Tip: Find your pace.
Day 1 28min jog Day 2 28min jog Day 3 30min jog .
2 Race Morning Arrive 45 min early.

Meta description: Crown Stub 100 (100 Mile) in Buxton, OR on Saturday, April 24, 2027. Registration, course details and race day info.
Register Now About Crown Stub 100 Crown Stub 100 is Bivouac Racing ' s 100-mile ultramarathon based at Stub Stewart State Park near Buxton, Oregon, with over 7,000 feet of climbing.
The first leg heads north on the Banks-Vernonia State Trail, around Vernonia Lake, then east on the Crown Zellerbach Trail for roughly 20 miles, turning before Scappoose.
After passing back through the park, runners head about 10 miles south on the Banks-Vernonia Trail to Banks and back, then finish with one 6.5-mile loop of the Stub Stewart Trail Challenge course.
Expect mostly asphalt on the Banks-Vernonia Trail, mostly hard-packed gravel on the Crown Zellerbach Trail, and about 10 percent dirt trail inside the park.
100-mile finishers earn a buckle.
The 100 starts at noon and the relay at 2 PM.

Meta description: Battle to the Pacific (5K, 15K, 20K, Ruck Challenge (35 lb), Ruck/Vest Light Weight (20 lb+)) in Hammond, OR on Saturday, November 21, 2026.
Choose a 5K, 15K or 20K run, or take on a ruck.
The Ruck Challenge carries a 35 lb pack (base weight, not counting food or water), and the Ruck/Vest Light Weight division carries 20 lb or more.
The Ruck Challenge measures you against the US Army standard of 12 miles with 35 lb in about three hours, and finishers who beat three hours earn a GET RUCKED " Exceeding the Standard " T-shirt.
Rucks start at 9:00 AM, the 15K and 20K at 9:15 AM, and the 5K at 9:30 AM.
